d: After questioning the Election Commission of India over its vote chori allegations for over a year now, Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and 10 other opposition leaders have now submitted to the Supreme Court 48 questions or interrogatories that they want to serve on the Election Commission of India. These questions pertain to details on the orders to conduct the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise, the decision-making process, orders regarding Form 6, appeals in West Bengal, and the digital infrastructure of ECINet.
